sources: Web search for a City of Magnolia (Rock County) web page or campground page: none found (magnoliamn.com is an unrelated accounting firm; cityofmagnoliamn.com, magnoliamn.org and magnoliamn.gov do not resolve); Luverne Area Chamber 'Places to Stay' and Rock County home page do not mention it (read 2026-11-11)
Google Maps panel 'Magnolia City Campground', 301 Luverne St. W, Magnolia, MN 56158: 4.5 stars, 35 reviews, no phone or website listed (read 2026-11-11)

values.note: Camper reports, 2024-2025: $20 a night for a hookup site, cash or check in the self-pay box; $5 to use the dump station.

fees.source: Campendium camper reports (Sept 30, 2025: '$20 cash or check only for site, $5 dump fee'; June 4, 2025: 'Our site was a full hook up site for $20/per night'; Aug 29, 2024: paid $20); the city publishes no page of its own. Read 2026-11-11

summary: No city or county page exists for the campground; Google Maps 4.5/35 (no phone or website) and 2024-2025 camper reports show it open, self-pay FCFS, $20 a night (reported). Hookups, site count and facilities left as stored. Not waterfront kept.
flags: PRESENCE QUESTION (local): no City of Magnolia website, and neither Rock County's site nor the Luverne Area Chamber's lodging list mentions the campground; the only web presence is directories (Explore Minnesota - 403 to plain HTTP, unread - Campendium, The Dyrt, RV Life) and Google Maps (4.5 stars from 35 reviews, 301 Luverne St. W, no phone, no website). Camper reports from June 2025 and September 30, 2025 show it operating ('$20 cash or check only for site').

Long-term occupants: a Campendium review of July 23, 2022 (1 star) says the spots were taken by long-term residents and the reviewer did not stay; the 2024-2025 reviews describe ordinary overnight stays ('only one other overnight camper').

Hookups unconfirmed: camper reports disagree (Sept 2025: 'not every site is FHU'; another says sewer at every site but water and electric at only three spots; 2024: 'About 11 sites with hook ups'). Stored derived electric 30 / water / sewer left alone; no operator page to settle it.
Phone: none stored; none found on any official page (a directory lists Magnolia City Hall at 507-227-0495 with stale 2022 data - not added).
Website: none stored and none exists; leave empty rather than add a directory link.
Pin: stored 43.64580,-96.08185 is ~60 m from Google's 43.64561,-96.08235; no move. Not waterfront kept (town park, no water nearby).
Note cleaned: dropped the site count/back-in, restrooms and the $20 (fields hold them).
note: Small City of Magnolia park off I-90, with a grassy tent area, playground and tennis and basketball courts. --Claude
